# Boise Handyman Co

> Handyman service for Boise, Idaho and the Treasure Valley: small home repairs, installs, and maintenance. Drywall repair, interior and exterior painting, minor plumbing and electrical, carpentry and trim, mounting and assembly, fence, deck and gutter repair, caulking and punch-list work. Serving Boise, Meridian, Eagle, Nampa, Kuna, Star, Middleton, Caldwell. Phone (208) 477-1169.

Pricing is a simple hourly rate plus a flat trip fee, quoted upfront before any work starts, and most jobs are finished in a single visit. Typical starting rates are a $49 trip fee plus $95 per hour with a one-hour minimum, so a single small repair starts around $145 (rates are being finalized; every job gets a written quote first). Work that needs a general contractor or a licensed trade, such as full remodels, additions, repipes, or panel work, is out of scope and referred out honestly.

## Services

- [Drywall Repair & Patching](https://boisehandyman.co/services/drywall-repair): Holes, cracks, water-stained patches, and popcorn-ceiling repairs finished and blended to match.
- [Interior & Exterior Painting](https://boisehandyman.co/services/painting-touch-ups): Room refreshes, trim and door repaints, and exterior touch-ups with proper prep and clean lines.
- [Minor Plumbing Repairs](https://boisehandyman.co/services/plumbing-repairs): Faucets, toilets, garbage disposals, supply lines, and slow drains fixed or swapped in a single visit.
- [Minor Electrical Repairs](https://boisehandyman.co/services/electrical-repairs): Outlets, switches, light fixtures, and ceiling fans replaced or repaired safely and to code.
- [Carpentry & Trim Repair](https://boisehandyman.co/services/carpentry-trim-repair): Doors that stick, damaged trim and baseboard, stair rails, and small carpentry fixes done cleanly.
- [Mounting & Assembly](https://boisehandyman.co/services/mounting-assembly): TVs, shelves, mirrors, and curtain rods mounted level and anchored right; furniture assembled fast.
- [Fence, Deck & Gutter Repair](https://boisehandyman.co/services/fence-deck-gutter-repair): Leaning fence panels, loose deck boards and rails, gutter cleaning, and minor exterior repairs.
- [Caulking & Home Maintenance](https://boisehandyman.co/services/home-maintenance): Caulking and weatherproofing, tile and grout touch-ups, and punch-list work knocked out in one trip.
- [RE-10 / Inspection Repairs](https://boisehandyman.co/re-10-repairs-boise): repairs from an Idaho RE-10 inspection response, completed and documented before closing, for real estate agents, buyers and sellers.
- [All Services](https://boisehandyman.co/services): plus city pages at /services/{service}/{city} and [Service Areas](https://boisehandyman.co/areas).
